'''Mrs. Makani''' (Japanese: '''マカニ様''' ''Mrs. Makani'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM017|Crystal-Clear Sleuthing!]]''.

She is a character who appeared in an episode of a [[Television|TV show]] called Alolan Detective Laki. Mrs. Makani is most likely not the actress's real name but rather the name of the character she portrays. She is a widow who received the Princess Tear from her late husband. In one episode of the TV show, the jewel was stolen. Detective [[Laki]] investigated the case and gathered all of his suspects in a single room, with Mrs. Makani also present. Laki deduced the thief was the doctor among the group, who had hidden the jewel in {{p|Sableye}} dolls. Mrs. Makani was relieved to have her precious jewels back.
